instruction: Owner authorizes first fine-tuning experiment: Explicit owner approval (2026-09-28): download SmolLM2 (smallest) and Gemma 3 270M; fine-tune on formalizer-v1 once the data rebuild is final, in order SmolLM2 -> Gemma 3 270M; Qwen3-0.6B only if the smaller models are not good enough. Goal: scientific comparison of how small the formalizer can be, with CPU speed measured. Semantic review for this experiment is satisfied by the independent automated auditor (experiment-grade, no human review). Preregistration (DS007, status/experiments.json) and dry-run precede any optimizer step; single GPU worker per machine.
